digest.component_or_area: LLM gate telemetry and usage logging
propositions: Gate runs compute loop-vs-breadth signal in failure_usage() but discard it at record() write, persisting only five token fields and dropping seven shape keys one frame before disk
Normal gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set record nothing at all, forcing operators to re-run instrumented for every tuning question
Success path never computes tool-call shape metrics, making failure and success rows asymmetric and both paths unable to answer breadth/loop questions
Tool-call loop vs breadth discrimination requires both total and distinct tool-call counts in durable storage, recoverable by query without re-running
Wiring the existing failure_usage() reducer into the success path and persisting its seven keys plus duration_s and ticket makes gate run shape durable and queryable
